//: Plugin main entries compile to CommonJS under dist-electron/plugins/<id>/main/ (the host imports them with import(pathToFileURL(...))). Runtime imports from ../shared/ emit CJS require() calls against the ESM shared/ files (fine on the Node inside Electron >= 22; module-type markers in scripts/build-plugins.mjs keep Node from sniffing). The emitted dist-electron/shared copies of ../shared/plugin-api are the same dead weight electron/tsconfig.json already produces.
